verdict.comment: The veteran SAISONS D'OR (nap) is taken to resume winning ways back down in trip. Arantes Nascimento is next best.

comments.arantesnascimento: Three good runs for new yard and he should be in the thick of it again
comments.highfieldviking: C&D winner; good run at Doncaster last week; in the mix with a repeat
comments.misemerald: On a losing run but retains ability; not at best on last two starts; back up in class
comments.phoenixfire: Winless since 2022; may come on for reappearance effort but he needs to
comments.rapidogirl: Yet to win a handicap but she's feasibly treated and conditions won't faze her; e-w shout
comments.saisonsdor: Veteran who comes here in fine form; returning to 7f in his favour; contender
comments.thapavc: Bath win (1m, firm) in May; respectable effort at Doncaster latest; fast pace would help
comments.thegoodbiscuit: Yet to win a handicap but on a dangerous mark and returning to 7f could suit
comments.travis: Infrequent winner but he's been threatening of late and conditions won't be an issue

verdict.comment: Easy Peeler has more to offer but PALS BATTALION should find this track more to his liking than Ripon last month.

comments.dakotagold: Rolled back the years with his Ripon win in April; well beaten next time but can revive
comments.easypeeler: 2-2 on good to firm; unexposed 3yo who won well at York last month; solid contender
comments.irishnectar: Good to firm a query but yard does well in this race and cheekpieces are now tried
comments.katsbob: Five wins for Ruth Carr this year, including C&D; should give it another good go
comments.manilascouse: Not fired in 2025 but 2nd in this race off 5lb higher last year; revival could be imminent
comments.mistersox: Excuses the last twice (class/draw) and thriving beforehand; chance if near his best
comments.mythicalphoenix: Frustrating last year but often ran well; encouraging reappearance and cheekpieces return
comments.orne: Down in the weights but 6f on fast ground looks an insufficient test
comments.palsbattalion: Looked to hate the track at Ripon latest; had been threatening something better beforehand
comments.reigningprofit: Two 5f wins this spring; handicapper in command since; opposable back up at 6f
comments.robertocaro: C&D win last year; good fourth from a poor draw at York latest; slower ground preferred
comments.secretguest: C&D win in May; less good twice since and could prove vulnerable once more
comments.tinto: Conditions to suit and ran a cracker over 5f here in May; should be involved

races.raceComment: katsbob is marginally preferred with a score of 59.3%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over easypeeler. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Maybe Lady Of The Garr's Wetherby's race can provide the answer. CALAFRIO is selected to come out on top of the five who reoppose.

comments.asadjumeirah: Beaten less than 1l by Lady Of The Garr last time; this slightly longer trip will suit
comments.calafrio: Won over C&D and unlucky in this race last year; hit traffic last time too; interesting
comments.canariaqueen: On a losing run but regularly attracts support; percentage call is to look elsewhere
comments.captainpickles: The sole 3yo; latest fifth was a step back in the right direction; not dismissed
comments.chesterlestreak: It's been a real struggle since joining this yard and he can't be recommended at present.
comments.crocustime: 0-22 and she became disappointing for Richard Hannon; stable debut
comments.doralee: Unexposed but it was a poor effort last time and she's not easy to support after that
comments.gisasub: On the downgrade for a while now; might pop back up one day but he's not a solid option
comments.goldenprosperity: Forced to race wide when beaten just 1l by Lady Of The Garr last time; not ruled out
comments.hurstwood: In good form, including here, until a poor run last time; needs to bounce back
comments.ifonlytheycudtalk: Won last September but not so good since and doesn't always look straightforward
comments.juryman: Respectable effort when beaten 1l over C&D in May but his overall profile is patchy
comments.korroor: Behind Golden Prospect last time and he's got a bit of work on to turn the tables
comments.ladyofthegarr: Had four of these behind when winning her first turf race latest; likely to go well again
comments.mrstrump: Penultimate run was good but went backwards next time; not easy to fancy after that
comments.quercus: Just failed to grab Lady Of The Garr at Wetherby last time; extra yardage a big plus
comments.raincap: Losing run stretches back to July 2023 and he's probably not the percentage call
comments.withoutflaw: Holding her form well over 5f in recent weeks; likely thereabouts again back at 6f

races.raceComment: calafrio is marginally preferred with a score of 49.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over goldenprosperity. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: It might be worth chancing CATBOY, who shaped quite well in a higher-grade race than this on his recent chasing debut.

comments.catboy: Made quite promising chase debut this month; no surprise if he builds on that effort here
comments.fennasloss: Well beaten all four starts for current stable, the latest over fences here last month
comments.henryboxbrown: Dual chase winner in 2024 (once over C&D); claims if recent run brought him on
comments.jacjumper: Below form when dropped back to 2m here in May but runner-up twice beforehand (2m5f/2m3f)
comments.jaipaletemps: 0-6 in Britain but came second here (2m) a fortnight ago and today's trip will also suit
comments.kingofthehill: Has claims if judged on Warwick second in March but two non-completions have followed
comments.kingofthestory: Best run since long absence when fourth over C&D last month; not ruled out each-way
comments.merseystreet: Made all over hurdles in January but not in the same form again since; chase debut; risky
comments.pennantlegacy: Struggled in first two handicap chases and is again a long way out of the weights here
comments.raindancequeen: Ran well for a long way over 2m7f here last month but was well held in the end
comments.shehasnotions: Out of sorts over hurdles lately but won race under Sean Bowen in 2024
comments.sirjackwest: Won over C&D in May 2023 but absent since that October
comments.zaconyrebel: Disappointing over hurdles for current stable since the autumn; reverts to chasing today

verdict.comment: It is hard to get away from VILLAGE MASTER (nap) who is selected to land his eighth win over fences. Second choice is Fame And Fun.

comments.alwaysbusy: Landed his second win over fences at Southwell last month; not so good over hurdles since.
comments.chemicalwarfare: Won at Sedgefield in April but well held since at Fakenham and here over hurdles in May.
comments.fameandfun: Encouraging third after a three-month break at Stratford last month.
comments.halondo: Encouraging chasing debut when second to Jubilant at Southwell in May.
comments.hellred: Won five over fences when trained by Paul Nicholls; pulled up at Uttoxeter last month.
comments.jubilant: Stepped up on his chasing debut when successful at Southwell in May; 3lb higher.
comments.tigerorchid: Has five course wins, the last of those in June last year off 2lb higher mark.
comments.villagemaster: 7-9 over fences and won at Stratford on his latest start in May; should run well.

races.raceComment: hellred is marginally preferred with a score of 64.2%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over villagemaster. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 8 wins from 20 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Excellent course form of 8/23 at worcester. Key attributes include optimal distance and improving, though step up in class need consideration.

comments.believeinthemoon: Made fairly encouraging rules debut over C&D last month but was 18l behind the top one

comments.missbarfad: Not disgraced on her first two starts but needs to take a good step forward here
comments.nelrose: Dam was placed on the Flat in France; stable does well in bumpers; one to consider
comments.openingdance: Soundly beaten at Fontwell in May but the new tongue-tie may enable improvement here

comments.spotthestar: Half-sister to a low-grade hurdle winner; dam a point winner; best watched on debut

comments.bellesbenefit: Won at Plumpton last October off 3lb lower mark; beaten thrice since.
comments.captainspick: Got off the mark at Perth last July off 2lb higher mark but has run poorly since.
comments.clondawroyale: Won at Haydock in December off 2lb higher mark but has gone off the boil in recent starts.
comments.findthetime: All five wins under rules when trained by Nicky Richards; largely regressive since.
comments.getuptheyard: Remains a maiden after 12 attempts but has been second on the last three occasions.
comments.hammerdan: Won twice last summer and made a solid return when second at Newton Abbot last month.
comments.letmegoboys: Yet to win under rules but was a fair third up in trip at Uttoxeter in May.
comments.redpanda: Well-beaten third of seven finishers at Warwick four weeks ago; steps up in trip.
comments.regalandroyal: Both hurdles wins came at Bangor last summer; should be suited by this step up in trip.
comments.tropicalspeed: Won at Stratford in March; subsequently beaten at Ffos Las and over fences at Uttoxeter.
comments.vorderman: Second at Plumpton in April, he had excuses in two non-completions since.

verdict.comment: Preference is for AL MOOTAMARID who can follow up his win at Stratford last month. Scintillante is second choice.

comments.almootamarid: Got off the mark at the fifth attempt over hurdles at Stratford last month.
comments.ascensionday: 0-12 under rules; pulled up on his stable debut over fences at Cartmel in May.
comments.cawthornebanker: Last of two wins came at Fontwell in May 2024 and has been regressive since.
comments.choirmaster: Should strip fitter for his first run in 616 days when sixth at Market Rasen last month.
comments.cityofruins: Has made the frame three times but remains a maiden; others preferred.
comments.leopoldsrock: Never showed when last of eight finishers on first outing in 606 days at Perth last month.
comments.playpretend: Hasn't gone on since making a winning hurdles debut at Market Rasen last June.
comments.scintillante: Got off the mark over hurdles when scoring over C&D in May off 4lb lower mark.
comments.sixtyplus: Unable to justify heavy market support on stable debut; may yet do better
comments.sweetserene: Yet to be placed from seven starts under rules and difficult to fancy.

races.raceComment: playpretend is marginally preferred with a score of 53.3%, holding clear edges in more progressive and more reliable profile over scintillante. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include improving.

verdict.comment: Only just denied at Fairyhouse in her first handicap, MOTHER MARA has good prospects of going one place better.

comments.afterlove: Half-sister to two Group 3 winners, three AW runs,  may find her level in handicaps now
comments.altimara: Noted staying on in mid-field over an extended 6f at the Curragh last time, could feature
comments.amberblossom: Has been unable to match her useful Dundalk form on turf, behind Rising Sky twice recently
comments.beautifulaffair: Placed twice at Dundalk during the winter, two undistinguished runs in turf handicaps
comments.boynevalley: Three handicap runs this year disappointing relative to decent maiden form at two
comments.bundleofinterest: Ran over three different trips at two; slight concern that her weakest run was over 7f
comments.etherealstar: Weak maiden form, dropped away to finish in rear on handicap debut, tongue-tie now
comments.justbefore: Leopardstown maiden winner last season, needs to find extra to open her handicap account
comments.kindatiny: May improve from recent seasonal debut, remains 10lb higher than her last winning mark
comments.mothermara: Beaten only a short head over 7f at Fairyhouse in May on handicap debut, leading chance
comments.oreeda: Has struggled in maidens, up against it from 6lb out of the handicap
comments.reponsefinale: Maiden, not a bad effort when a staying-on seventh in a 1m handicap at Cork last time
comments.risingsky: Promising fourth placings at Roscommon and Leopardstown, latter form boosted by the winner
comments.schoolofathens: Good run over 1m at Gowran in first-time blinkers, less effective in cheekpieces latest
comments.waitforit: Has a good AW run to her name, a long way below that form in two turf outings this term

races.raceComment: justbefore is marginally preferred with a score of 36.8%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and more progressive over amberblossom. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Over this more galloping track, recent Ballinrobe second GLENROYAL gets the vote over stablemate Magnolia Drive

comments.ballymagreehan: Unexposed and worth a market check; yard had a winner in these colours at the Curragh
comments.boutella: More exposed than stablemate Ballymagreehan although has a lower turf mark than AW
comments.calabonita: No luck in running at Down Royal last time so that run forgiven and remains of interest
comments.canikissyou: Hasn't really threatened in three maidens; opposable off this opening mark
comments.faoladh: Much improved over 1m recently; 10lb higher but big chance if staying longer trip
comments.glenroyal: Flew home to dead-heat for second with Magnolia Drive at Ballinrobe; big chance
comments.greatmover: Bit onepaced at Cork on better ground; visor now fitted and claims
comments.magnoliadrive: Dead-heated with Glenroyal at Ballinrobe; that rival may have more improvement in him
comments.onemoredance: C&D winner and recent Gowran second better again; big player
comments.realpetite: Slow to break and keen when never counting on handicap debut at Navan in April
comments.tofino: Never counted after slow start at Limerick last time; cheekpieces fitted now
comments.vlhova: Closely matched with You Are Mine on Cork running; contender if staying this longer trip
comments.wonderfulwonderful: Not one to rule out on handicap debut but others preferred

races.raceComment: onemoredance is confidently preferred with a score of 46.5%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip over faoladh. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: If sustaining the improvement shown at Leopardstown last time THEGOOSEISCOOKED may gain a belated success with Colin Keane aboard

comments.chouchou: Well-exposed maiden, has failed to build on a fifth placing over 1m at Gowran in April
comments.cryptocrash: Drop to this trip produced an improved display that saw him finish fourth at Leopardstown
comments.escapeact: 1m winner on soft in Britain, no sign of his best form in three outings for this stable
comments.famousenough: Third reserve, competitive in two Gowran outings in May, flopped when fancied on latest
comments.gatsbycap: Six-time winner, two 2024 wins came at Dundalk, no turf success since 2021, little appeal
comments.harrieteagle: Second reserve, now 4lb below last season's winning mark, needs to show signs of revival
comments.limestonered: AW winner in 2023, hard to make a case for him, perhaps blinkers will elicit improvement.
comments.madamalkaterina: 66-1 when in rear on handicap debut at Gowran, held by sixth-placed Pegasus Of Harry
comments.metamorpheus: Winning hurdler whose Flat form is not particularly convincing, place chance at best
comments.morningapproach: Three of four wins have been gained on AW, yet to hit form this turf campaign
comments.obamaarmy: Beaten around 9l in two 1m1f races at Leopardstown, needs to find extra to feature
comments.pegasusofharry: 1m4f AW winner in Britain, 0-5 on turf, recent Gowran fifth was a step in the direction
comments.pinksocks: One win from 28 starts, runner-up six times including on final 2024 run; weak 2025 form
comments.princessrabab: Won a 1m4f handicap early last year for Joseph O'Brien, has to overcome a lengthy absence
comments.rankoexpress: First reserve, two turf outings this term well below the standard of Dundalk winter form
comments.rochestermike: Started the season brightly when fifth at Cork, had a valid excuse at Gowran a month ago
comments.sharethetreasure: 15-race maiden, has shown only glimpses of her best form since a Gowran second last year
comments.steptosomewhere: Began the campaign well with a Navan handicap third, subsequent form much less appealing
comments.thegooseiscooked: Good run last time from career-low mark, Colin Keane rides for the first time, interesting

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: Following his luckless run at Newbury, SUDU could be a warm order to gain compensation. Big Bear Hug is feared most.

comments.bigbearhug: Won here last July and at Goodwood (1m4f) last month on debut for new trainer
comments.goldencircet: A win and two places from his last three starts, all on good to firm; firmly in the mix
comments.graham: Last of nine on Flat return (7-1) 12 days ago; well treated on his form of last May/June
comments.navid: Newbury third (1m4f) but Sudu, just a neck behind, encountered a stack of traffic problems
comments.pappalouis: Chester second (1m2f) was easily best of four runs this season; 1m4f now; first tongue-tie
comments.sudu: Repeatedly checked in his run when fourth (neck behind Navid) over 1m4f at Newbury latest
comments.vaynor: Latest win was in September 2023 and he's not shown that form since

races.raceComment: bigbearhug is confidently preferred with a score of 54.5%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over goldencircet. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 18 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include excellent form and strong course form, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside to middle position preferred around right-handed bends

verdict.comment: A chance is taken that FIGHTING POET can stage the same revival he produced in this race last year, only this time go one better.

comments.abitiffy: Well beaten all four races, latest on handicap debut (1m2f, good) in a hood
comments.arenasdeltiempo: No win since 2021; she came last at Brighton (sole run with a tongue-tie) when last seen
comments.certainstyle: Perhaps stole her only win and has reverted to lesser shows since; ninth in this last year
comments.charlesmorin: With minor honours on last two starts and down the weights, he has an each-way chance
comments.emilyrebecca: Trying about 1m4f on two of her last three outings has not seen her in such a good light
comments.fightingpoet: Low-level form this term but also unheralded when beaten a neck at 33-1 in this last year
comments.jacklangley: Makes turf/handicap debut, having won at Lingfield (1m4f) in his first classified
comments.pabloprince: Has had only five turf runs, showing some ability but there seem to be more solid options
comments.ruperttheprince: Vastly more competitive on classified debut at Lingfield (11.6f, good to firm) 11 days ago
comments.stintinosunset: Won off 1lb higher at Windsor last September and close third there on latest outing
comments.woottonpalace: Soundly beaten when sent handicapping in visor/cheekpieces last two starts; tongue-tie now

races.raceComment: stintinosunset is marginally preferred with a score of 48.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more reliable profile over fightingpoet. Won 1 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having shown some solid form in defeat in 3yo handicaps this year, MISS COLLADA is taken to post her first win of the season.

comments.auroramajesty: Won in March on first two starts but merely sixth in his first two handicaps
comments.braveempire: Form went wrong way last summer and down the field in May on first two runs for this yard
comments.diamondonthehill: Enjoying a consistent year and won at Lingfield two starts ago; key player
comments.dreamofmischief: Below par on last two starts but first-time blinkers are an interesting angle; C&D winner
comments.hodler: Arrives in pretty good heart and two of his last three wins have come over this C&D
comments.mafnood: Promising third here on yard debut; hasn't kicked on but worth a second look back at Epsom
comments.marlaypark: Four-time C&D winner who drops back down in grade and is capable of being involved
comments.misscollada: 3yo who has run well in defeat on two of her last three starts and could be thereabouts

races.raceComment: dreamofmischief is marginally preferred with a score of 52.0%. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.savannahsmiles: Dual course winner over 6f; only just caught by a stablemate at Bath a week ago; respected
comments.somenightmare: Five wins here, but has finished behind Level Up in his last two starts; work to do

verdict.comment: The unexposed FILLY'S LAST LADY looks the one to be on with last month's successful handicap debut at Bath having been boosted.

comments.alshimali: 0-10 but has shown ability, as when fourth last time; frame possibilities
comments.fillyslastlady: 4lb higher than when making a successful handicap debut and the form has been boosted
comments.fouradaay: Not easy to win with but latest Windsor third has since been franked; high on list
comments.gogoyubari: Losing run up to 17; hard to warm to despite dropping into a 0-55 for the first time
comments.ladymonroe: Poor form in beating one rival in four starts; has a BHA rating of 10
comments.peacheycarnehan: Losing run up to 21; effectively 9lb wrong on his 168th start; look elsewhere
comments.sunkeeper: Not beaten far last time but refused to race in both intended starts prior to that
comments.triplecharged: 0-14 and blinkers made no difference last time; passed over
comments.zamandaar: 1-17; latest Yarmouth second may not add up to much; others preferred

races.raceComment: zamandaar is marginally preferred with a score of 46.4%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over gogoyubari. verdict.comment: The vote goes to FISHERMANS COTTAGE who looks ready to win again having run consistently well since returning in May.

comments.aladyforever: Has run well since returning from a mammoth absence in February; shouldn't be far away
comments.bluesymoon: 0-13 and more will be needed to break her duck, even at this level
comments.captainbentley: Poor form over the past year and now 0-18; plenty to find, even at this level
comments.fishermanscottage: Runner-up in a 0-55 handicap over C&D nine days ago and that reads well in this company
comments.fregola: 0-11; hard to fancy having been well beaten in a similar contest at Leicester last month
comments.glamorousjewel: Seemed to run above herself in a handicap over C&D in May but needs to back it up
comments.ladydorchester: Has shown little this term and is now 0-14; drop in grade the main positive
comments.marcus: 0-20 and needs to pull out more; usually wears headgear but the visor is a first
comments.midnightcall: 0-5, but ran well when third over 6f here last time; respected down at this level
comments.myboyharry: Won a similar contest at Brighton eight days ago; close 3rd there yesterday; 6lb penalty

races.raceComment: fishermanscottage is confidently preferred with a score of 46.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over marcus. races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: It may be worth siding with the 3yo CASUAL ENCOUNTER who could be well suited by this greater stamina test.

comments.arcimboldo: Poor form in all three starts; bred to stay but big improvement needed; blinkers on
comments.blacksmoke: Rarely seen on grass these days (sole turf win came on soft ground); opposable
comments.casualencounter: Better efforts since returning last month; this stiffer test may be just what she needs
comments.sneakyblinder: 1lb below last winning mark; had excuses last time but still has stamina to prove
comments.starofjupiter: Modest since winning an AW classified event in February; up half a mile in trip
comments.utherpendragon: Does stay this far, but losing run up to 51 so he makes limited appeal
comments.zooks: Consistent this year and ran well when third over 2m at Catterick on penultimate outing

races.raceComment: zooks is marginally preferred with a score of 45.9%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and stronger recent form and more reliable profile over sneakyblinder. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include consistent performer, though unfavorable draw and regressive form need consideration.
